gate1_rule: paired cluster-bootstrap CI excludes 0 AND point estimate >= 0.053 AND both mu_ctx granularities same sign AND abs/FC/S2 not degraded
cluster_field: held-out compound (37 train compounds with mechanism text)
k_full_span_note: fit set = 36 other non-control compounds, so the full linear span is k=36 (the plan's 39 assumed 40 compounds incl. the 3 vehicle controls, which carry no mechanism text)

capacity_rule.note: 35/37 folds; k=full span exempt, never carries a PASS

abstention_rule: compounds without substantive mechanism text get a = 0 (exact fallback); no mechanism is guessed

outcomes.i_PASS: rho_bar >= 0.20 AND cluster-bootstrap CI low > delta
outcomes.ii_SPAN_CLOSED: one-sided 95% upper bound of rho_oracle(k=36) < 0.20; wording restricted to linear transfer from the fit-set span
outcomes.iii_REPRESENTATION_GAP: every eligible channel CI high < delta AND no channel point estimate > delta/2
outcomes.iv_INDETERMINATE: anything else -- explicitly NOT a contribution
outcomes.v_UNDERPOWERED: no delta under the cap reaches P(REP GAP | rho=0) >= 0.80 -- explicitly NOT a contribution

discipline.post_data_threshold_moves: forbidden; any move voids all conclusions
